FinancialDashboard.title: Financial Dashboard Data
FinancialDashboard.description: User personal financial state including accounts, incomes, obligations, installments, expenses, and savings.

userId.description: The UID of the owner user.

installments.description: List of BNPL and other installment plans.

savings.description: List of savings deposits and targets.

liabilities.description: List of liabilities and long-term debts.

receivables.description: List of money owed to the user.

/users/{userId}/data/financial_dashboard.description: User specific dashboard document containing all financial state.
